title: Bug Fixes & Security Hardening
headline: GPU telemetry now correctly tracks your selected card on multi-GPU systems, the landing page no longer flashes on load, and several security and reliability fixes ship under the hood.
changes: Fixed GPU telemetry showing wrong card's data on multi-GPU systems — now matches by name instead of raw array index
Fixed white flash on landing page load and right-edge scrollbar border on Windows
Fixed power plan manager admin path silently reporting success when individual powercfg commands failed
Hardened checkout webhook — prevents multi-item cart bypass edge case
Fixed trial expiry mis-comparison when trialEndsAt is null or invalid
Fixed admin reset-trial endpoint missing input validation
Removed wasteful WMI query in Extreme Labs analysis that ran but was never used
